title: queens-nimbers: a solver and verification package for the Non-Attacking Queens game
description: A solver for the adversarial Non-Attacking Queens game, which is Node Kayles on the n-queens graph, together with the verification resources behind two results: the 18x18 game is a first-player win, established by two independently configured proving runs that agree on the verdict, the winning opening, and the full 15-ply principal variation; and the Sprague-Grundy values G(14)=0, G(15)=1, G(16)=0, G(17)=2, which extend OEIS A344227 beyond its catalogued range and refute the eventual 1,0-oscillation conjecture recorded there. The package contains the solver ladder from a memo-less negamax ground truth up to the production kernel, the getK dense leaf evaluator, a sorry-free Lean 4 development of the leaf evaluator's recurrence and Grundy semantics, the differential and lineage test gates, the frozen run configurations, and the OEIS extension package with its b-file.
